removeSpellAreas.name: Remove spell areas from chat
removeSpellAreas.hint: Adds a Remove Area button to the spell card and its linked damage card.

unconsciousAtZeroHP.name: Unconscious at 0 HP
unconsciousAtZeroHP.hint: Applies the condition at 0 HP and removes the module's effect when at least 1 HP is restored.

combatAmmo.name: Track combat ammunition
combatAmmo.hint: Reports ammunition spent and recoverable after combat. While the standalone ammunition module is active, it handles tracking.

MJLQOL.RemoveAreaError: Could not remove the spell area.
MJLQOL.AmmoEmpty: This weapon is out of compatible ammunition.
